"'''Mobiles'''", as they were called by [[Ozurist]], were maintenance droids in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] whose programming became corrupted following the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. Droids of all sizes, shapes, and purposes rebelled against their programming and attempted to make war upon the biological inhabitants of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
The original mobiles were ordinary droids that worked in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], ranging from [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] and [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] droids to powerful [[Security droid/Legends|security]] droids and [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]]. But during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the programming of many of these droids became corrupted. They turned against the biological inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], seizing control of much of [[The Works/Legends|The Works]]. As they continued to "convert" other droids, the threat they posed grew to the point where the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was forced to send troopers down into the Works to combat them.<ref name="TOR" />

Around the year [[3643 BBY]], a group of mobiles attempted to destroy the machines known by [[Ozurist]] as [[Thermodraft]]. Thermodraft's destruction would result in a massive explosion and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] leak, which would kill an untold number of civilians. To stop this threat, Ozurist asked a traveling hero to venture into the Works and repair Thermodraft. The hero fought their way through the mobiles, defeating many of them and managing to repair the machine, preventing the catastrophe.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mobiles appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. They, along with the [[Cthon/Legends|Cthon]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] troops, serve as the main enemies throughout the Works section of Coruscant, the Republic characters' capital planet.
